SYNC_TOKEN.description: Fork-Sync-All automation credential. Use a 90-day expiry and review permissions before generating.

fine_grained.reason: Consumers require broad organization, audit, hook, package deletion, repository and workflow capabilities; drop-in fine-grained parity is unproven.

GH_SYNC_TOKEN.description: Fork-Sync-All mirror watchdog credential. Use a 90-day expiry and verify current consumer access.

fine_grained.reason: Consumers require broad organization, hooks, public-key, audit, package and repository capabilities; no verified drop-in profile yet.

ADD_MIRROR_REPO_SYNC.description: Fork-Sync-All mirror repository provisioning credential. Use a 90-day expiry and verify organization access.

fine_grained.reason: Repository creation and organization hook/discovery parity have not been proven.

OSP_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Temporary bridge for Fork-Sync-All organization Actions-secret rotation in OpenOS-Project-OSP. Use 90 days; prefer the scoped GitHub App when available.

fine_grained.reason: Organization Actions-secret API compatibility needs an explicit fine-grained permission audit; GitHub App is preferred.

MIRROR_TOKEN.description: OpenOS-Project-OSP mirror automation credential. Use 90 days and review all listed capabilities.

fine_grained.reason: Current mirror workflows require broad organization/enterprise administration, hooks, keys, repository and workflow capabilities.

ORG_MIRROR_OSP_TO_OOC.description: Backing credential for the OSP-to-OOC organization mirror secret. Shared with MIRROR_TOKEN; rotate once and update required secret destinations. Use 90 days.

fine_grained.reason: Same backing credential as MIRROR_TOKEN; fine-grained parity is unproven.

GITLAB_SYNC_TOKEN.description: Fork-Sync-All GitLab synchronization credential. Use 90 days where policy permits.
